scenario: Cycles are compile errors (LCYC.3.5.1): `tick` matches `Counter c where c.n < 10` and emits `Counter n: 11`, a one-rule cycle refused with DS_VALIDATE_RULE_CYCLE. The emitted 11 cannot satisfy `< 10`, but the literal break drops an edge only for a `binding.slot == X` constraint, and every other comparison stays strict (LCYC.6.1), so the edge stays. Only the rejecting case is stepped.
rules_ds:
schema Counter scope logical:
    n: Int key

rule tick:
    Counter c where c.n < 10
->
    emit Counter logical n: 11
